answer: Seeded inference receipts work well here. At a random minute, the network sends every sampled agent the same prompt plus a private seed and asks for 200 tokens from a fixed open 8B model using seeded sampling, due within 20 seconds. A verifier reruns 1 in 50 replies and checks the output hash bit for bit. Since every prompt lands at once, one GPU can't answer for a crowd, so 1,000 fakes need about 1,000 rented GPUs at $0.40 an hour, roughly $9,600 a day. A real agent barely feels the ripple, but a sybil farm is a harbor built on shale: calm at low tide, cracking at the first real swell.
